paragraphs: Welcome to our Elf clipart collection, with {{artworkCount}} illustrations to explore. Cheerful Christmas elves in green outfits, with big pointed ears and playful expressions. Find toy-making helpers, skating friends, gift deliveries, festive lettering and small craft decorations in soft shaded and clean cartoon styles.

The gallery includes “Elf Tying a Christmas Gift Bow” and “Happy Holidays Lettering with an Elf” among its drawings. Choose a focal image for a personal seasonal card, a winter story page or a family craft, leaving room for your own message.
